_comment: Golden dev set for retrieval + generation evaluation. Every item is grounded in LIVE ingested media — no synthetic content. Each `evidence` string was read out of the indexed corpus before being written here, so labels are verifiable. Relevance is defined by evidence appearing in a chunk (not by chunk ID), which keeps labels valid across re-chunking and embedder swaps. Keep the set small and honest; grow it from observed failures (error analysis), not speculation. ASR transcripts are unpunctuated and sometimes mis-spell names, so evidence strings use the spelling that actually appears in the transcript.
